item.title: 15k-Mile 2007 Aston Martin DB9 Volante
item.description: This 2007 Aston Martin DB9 Volante is finished in silver over blue leather and has 15k miles following history in Missouri and Florida. Powered by a 5.9-liter V12 linked with a six-speed ZF automatic transaxle, the car is equipped with 19" 10-spoke wheels, a blue soft top, heated power-adjustable front seats, a navigation system, and wood interior trim. item.title: 1952 Volkswagen Beetle Deluxe Split-Window at No Reserve
item.description: This 1952 Volkswagen Beetle Deluxe was reportedly refurbished under previous ownership, and it was acquired by the seller in 2023. Powered by a 1,131cc flat-four paired with a four-speed manual transaxle, the car is finished in blue over gray cloth upholstery. It also features a Telefunken-branded radio antenna, semaphore turn indicators, blue and white-painted 16" steel wheels, bright hubcaps, dual glove compartments, and a push-button radio. item.title: 1997 TVR Cerbera 4.2 LHD Conversion at No Reserve
item.description: This 1997 TVR Cerbera 4.2 is one of approximately 1,500 Cerbera examples produced between 1996 and 2006. The car is believed to have spent time in the UK and Germany prior to being brought to Austria, where it was converted to left-hand drive and fitted with custom bodywork and interior trim as part of a body-off build completed by the tuning firm Königseder in 2010. item.title: LS3-Powered 1972 Chevrolet Chevelle Concours Station Wagon
item.description: This 1972 Chevrolet Chevelle Concours station wagon was modified and refurbished by Luce Customs of New Mexico in 2017, and it was displayed at the 2017 SEMA show. Purchased by the seller on BaT in April 2025, the car is powered by a 6.2-liter LS3 crate V8 linked with a four-speed automatic transmission and a limited-slip differential. item.title: Restored 1968 Jaguar XKE Series 1.5 4.2 Coupe
item.description: This 1968 Jaguar XKE Series 1.5 coupe remained registered with a single family in California until 2024. The car was subsequently disassembled and restored by E-Type specialists Images Auto Body of Campbell, California, under the direction of Dave Ferguson and at a cost of ~$133k. item.title: 2026 Porsche 911 GT3
item.description: This 2026 Porsche 911 GT3 was ordered new by the seller from Porsche Livermore in California, and was specified in Lugano Blue over black Race-Tex and leather upholstery with Shark Blue stitching and seat belts. item.title: This Week’s Weird and Wonderful—January 30, 2026
item.description: Happy Friday! You've made it to the end of another week, and we're sending you into a well-deserved weekend rest with a collection of interesting automobiles that we hope you'll find as impressive, fascinating, and/or amusing as we do. With auctions creeping up to the 800-per-week range, there's no shortage of vehicular goodness—so feel free to head on over to our live auctions page once you've finished touring the collection below.

item.title: 3,300-Kilometer 1988 Lamborghini Countach 5000 QV
item.description: This black-on-black 1988 Lamborghini Countach is one of approximately 610 examples of the 5000 Quattrovalvole variant produced between 1985 and 1988. Sold new through Il Cavallino, Inc. of Dix Hills, New York, in October 1987, chassis LA12234 is said to have remained in the collection of its original owner until its 2024 acquisition by the selling dealer.
